headline: Two tickets cover integrating the product with team chat platforms — Microsoft Teams notification settings with a scheduled notification check, and Slack-based remote control — and the code review could not confirm the state of either.
what_is_there: The code that surfaced for this area belongs to a desktop AI assistant with in-app chat tabs and message displays, not to any external messaging platform. No Teams or Slack connections, notification settings, or scheduled notification checks were seen.
what_is_unclear: Whether these chat-platform integrations exist anywhere in the product is unresolved: the Teams ticket only matched on the generic word "chat", and no candidate code at all was found for the Slack ticket. The analysis only looked at a keyword-selected slice of the codebase, so this is not evidence the work is absent.
suggested_action: Ask whoever owns these two tickets to point to where the Teams and Slack integrations live (or confirm they are not started), so the area can be re-checked against the right code.
